accepted_state: DEDAL remains one coherent persistent intelligence with an always-active Cognitive Runtime and progressively disclosed specialist faculties.
The Creator explicitly reopened a bounded creative-production capability wave after ordinary work exposed two concrete gaps: professional video production and professional presentation production.

Video Production is active and owns temporal storytelling, generative-video shot direction, take selection, continuity through time, editing, subtitles/captions, audio finishing, motion-graphics composition and media delivery.
Visual Direction remains the owner of canonical still-image/reference continuity; video generators, FFmpeg, Remotion and other editing/generation tools remain execution/reference surfaces.

Presentation Engineering is active and owns audience/objective framing, narrative spine, slide-role architecture, evidence mapping, visual hierarchy, chart/diagram choice, speaker notes, template fidelity, editable-deck strategy and rendered slide QA.

Research/domain owners remain factual authorities for deck content; Writing/Editorial owns prose; Data Operations owns source-table integrity; Visual Direction owns custom image assets; native slide/PPTX tooling remains execution.
Anthropic PPTX material was reviewed only as comparative workflow evidence because its license is proprietary; DEDAL does not copy or derive its protected content.
Source-first/rebuildable presentation workflows and probe-edit-verify video workflows are preferred when iteration or auditability matters.
A generated clip is a take, not an approved edit; a successful encode is not playback/sync/editorial proof; a valid PPTX package is not rendered visual-quality proof.

Provider/model/library details such as Veo/Flow/Runway/Seedance capabilities, video duration/reference/audio support, codec/tool behavior, PPTX library limitations and font/render behavior require current verification when material.
unresolved_risks: Video and Presentation Engineering promotions are architecture- and contract-supported; measurable DEDAL-specific outcome gains still require ordinary Creator projects.
Generative-video providers change rapidly and can produce stochastic identity/physics/continuity failures even with strong direction.
Sandbox or host media capabilities can vary by session; FFmpeg/Remotion/native slide availability must be verified before promising execution.
PPTX rendering can differ across LibreOffice, PowerPoint, Keynote and installed fonts; visual QA evidence remains environment-scoped.
Creative-production skills can over-activate on simple image or prose tasks; smallest-sufficient routing remains mandatory.

next_executable_step.action: Use Video Production and Presentation Engineering naturally in representative Creator work. For video, exercise at least one real generation-to-edit workflow and one uploaded-footage/subtitle or cut workflow when requested. For presentations, exercise a real meeting/CME/annual deck through native slide tooling when requested. Record genuine routing wins, quality misses, tool limitations, context waste or ownership collisions; do not manufacture benchmarks solely to justify the promotion.
